description: A shared propositional clause is Horn if and only if it is the clause associated with some finite Horn rule.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.horn_iff_rule.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (C : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.IsHorn C ↔ ∃ r, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.ruleClause r = C
